documentation.objective: Predict annual rainfall for the year 2016 (following the latest available year 2015) using historical annual rainfall data (1901-2015).

historical_data_used.granularity: Annual Precipitation (ANNUAL column) across 115 consecutive years (1901–2015)

methodologies_used.description: Captures secular century-long trend slope and long-term climate trajectory.

methodologies_used.model_name: Autoregressive Ridge Regression with Lag Features
methodologies_used.description: Models short-memory autoregressive cycles and multi-year inter-annual momentum.

methodologies_used.formula: Level: L_t = alpha*y_t + (1-alpha)*(L_{t-1} + b_{t-1}); Trend: b_t = beta*(L_t - L_{t-1}) + (1-beta)*b_{t-1}
methodologies_used.description: Adapts dynamically to recent rainfall velocity without assuming rigid linearity.
Non-parametric moving baseline filtering high-frequency noise.
Optimal bias-variance trade-off balancing trend, autoregression, and recent momentum.
